title: ENTROPY — Atmospheric Escape：双屏幕的视觉世界
titleEn: ENTROPY — Atmospheric Escape: A Two-Screen Visual World
summary: 围绕航天器、星图和科学终端语言，为超宽主屏与顶部屏幕组织可演奏的视觉状态，并以浏览器预演和实时媒体缩短现场制作的反馈距离。
summaryEn: A process note on building a coordinated visual world for an ultra-wide display and a ceiling screen, combining authored spacecraft imagery, controllable states and browser-based previsualisation.
